thread:
Priya (PM): quick sync — we need a decision on the sawtooth constraint cuts for MVP vs v1. timeline may slip if we don't shrink scope today
Ravi (Eng): we can drop the per-tenant analytics and keep a single global metric stream to save ~2 weeks of infra work
Lena (Design): losing per-tenant will impact onboarding UX for Acme and BetaPilot, they'll lose their rollout dashboards
Maya (Product): can we ship a thin dashboard (read-only) for tenants in v1 and keep full per-tenant controls for v2?
Ravi (Eng): thin read-only is doable in ~4 days, full controls are the heavy work (2+ sprints). that's a nice compromise
Sam (Data): note that the global stream reduces cardinality, but inference telemetry will be noisy for tenant-level regressions. we should add sampled tenant tags to avoid blind spots
Omar (SRE): ops concerns — global stream reduces egress and index costs; autoscaling simpler. but we need a fallback plan if a single noisy tenant floods the pipeline
Priya (PM): decision proposal: MVP = global stream + sampled tenant tags + thin read-only dashboards. v1 backlog: per-tenant controls + RBAC + historical retention. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Lena (Design): agree with proposal. will stub thin dashboard screens and provide copy for onboarding in 48h
Ravi (Eng): ok, I'll update the cutlist and ETA. tentative: MVP ship window unchanged, but feature parity for v1 delayed 6 weeks
Sam (Data): I'll define sampling schema and a small eval to estimate detection latency. ping me for dataset access
Omar (SRE): adding temporary circuit-breaker to protect pipeline — I can get that in during the MVP rollout
Maya (Product): @release-bot label: scope-approved-mvp? :thumbsup:
release-bot: label applied: scope-approved-mvp
Priya (PM): next steps: 1) Ravi update cutlist + timeline (owner: Ravi) 2) Lena deliver thin-dashboard mocks (owner: Lena) 3) Sam sampling schema + eval (owner: Sam) 4) Omar circuit-breaker (owner: Omar). Check-in tomorrow 10am PT
Ravi (Eng): will do. I'll also add a brief note for acme customer comms about known limitations
Lena (Design): mock ETA = tomorrow 9am PT, will add two states: empty and sample-data
Sam (Data): I'll post the sampling numbers by 6pm PT today
Omar (SRE): circuit-breaker PR by EOD, will tag Priya for risk review
Priya (PM): thanks team. if anyone sees a hard blocker, flag here. otherwise we'll treat this as the MVP cut and proceed with canary plan :rocket:
Maya (Product): adding retrospective ticket to capture customer pain for v1 decisions
Ravi (Eng): noted. tagging the rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/rollouts#1768888888
Priya (PM): last: consensus? please react with :thumbsup: if you agree, :eyes: if you want changes
Lena (Design): :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sam (Data): :thumbsup:
Omar (SRE): :thumbsup:
